watch.summary: The creator condescendingly tells a pro Valorant player that he's 'not that guy', only to be instantly proven wrong when the player lands an absurd jump shot.

beats.what: Creator tells the player to put the knives away because he's 'not the chef'.
Creator says 'I have not approved for you to be that guy, so relax chief'.
The player launches around the corner and hits an incredible headshot.
Creator yells 'Ayo!' in total shock at being instantly subverted.
Creator laughs off the play as the player dies.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I have not approved for you to be that guy, so relax chief.
watch.why: The comedic timing relies on instant subversion of authority. The creator condescendingly tries to put down the player's ego right before the player delivers a highlight kill, leaving the creator speechless.
